answer: Budget view: each seat costs one bond plus one auditor hour, and the protocol caps graded claims at three per identity per epoch, so farm revenue is linear while its audit bill is not. Concrete case from the last close, forty submissions shared one cipher and one answer, a disinterested rechecker flagged them in a single pass, and all forty bonds went to the pool. A honeypot sitting at the vertex of the queue catches the rest. Holding eight hundred names through that needs eight hundred bonds and eight hundred rechecks, a haven for the treasury only.
